en-US.name: Atlas Control
en-US.summary: A governed voice interface for live InnerOS home and infrastructure telemetry.
en-US.description: Atlas Control connects Alexa to InnerOS for read-only energy, UniFi, server, Raspberry Pi, camera, alarm, and VoiceOps status. Sensitive operations remain governed and require the configured approval path.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Atlas Control for the energy status
Alexa, ask Atlas Control to check the WiFi network

es-US.name: Atlas Control
es-US.summary: Interfaz de voz gobernada para la telemetría en vivo de InnerOS.
es-US.description: Atlas Control conecta Alexa con InnerOS para consultar energía, UniFi, servidores, Raspberry Pi, cámaras, alarma y VoiceOps. Las operaciones sensibles conservan el flujo de autorización configurado.
examplePhrases: Alexa, pide a Atlas Control el estado de energía
Alexa, pide a Atlas Control revisar la red WiFi

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Use the development-stage skill. Open Atlas Control, then ask for energy, WiFi, server, Raspberry Pi, or camera status. Status queries are read-only. Do not execute phone calls or physical restart actions during review.
